body.text: One fire spell cast: immediate dry resin crack, a forceful short furnace exhale, then sparse ember grit dying away. Raw physical pressure, close and dry, no voice, no music, no repeated attacks. Two seconds including tail.

body.prompt: Original dark fantasy arena underscore, ritual skin percussion and abrasive bowed bass drones. Worn bronze rattles, forceful human physicality, narrow ember-like harmonics. Instrumental, no voices. 96 BPM in 4/4, steady pulse. First 5 seconds establish sparse tension, next 10 add interlocking frame drums, last 5 sustain pressure without a finale. Twenty second style sketch, no pop beat, no modern drum kit, no fade out.
